notes.title: First new DLC chapter The Lost Depths announced!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796408/63362e6a492c3f960ae13fca77c92d0c4ae454df.png[/img]

[h2]Explore the depths of the lost city of Atlantis and rebuild an ancient artefact.[/h2]

[b]Coming Soon[/b] to [b]Steam[/b] - Venture deeper into the mystery of [b]Infinite Inside[/b] with [b]The Lost Depths[/b], the first new DLC chapter that delves into the influence of the Plinth on ancient mythology. A new Plinth appears, sending you on a journey to rebuild a crucial artefact and deliver it to the lost civilisation of [b]Atlantis[/b].

[previewyoutube=dSSiITscZ_0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]A Unique Adventure[/h3]

Discover a newly designed level inspired by [b]Atlantis[/b], featuring ethereal underwater environments, expanded game mechanics, and fresh puzzles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796408/c670a6520c152a185c2aca2ae1c23c500eb771ef.png[/img]
[h3]Introducing the Challenge Room[/h3]

Prove your skill to the Plinth in a timed challenge, solving a vital puzzle before the room closes in. Complete this trial to gain the Plinth’s trust in delivering the artefact.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796408/8e6f47ab2658e2c4acea2d4e8a243f0b160c4cc3.png[/img]

[h3]Replayable Challenges[/h3]

Once unlocked, revisit the [b]Challenge Room[/b] with other keys from the game, offering new ways to test yourself and master the puzzles. Compete for the fastest solve time and top the global leaderboard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796408/1e466a18f854b39ce1904dcb7577bc37a4757cae.png[/img]

[h3]Wishlist Now![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2729540/The_Infinite_Inside

notes.title: Infinite Inside Patch 1 - Visual Quality Update Released
notes.content:
[h1][/h1]

[i]Thank you for the fantastic feedback on the release of Infinite Inside. We are thrilled to announce the release of the first patch for Infinite Inside! [/i]

[b]Check out the details below![/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Enhanced Visuals: [/b]Higher resolution on PCVR.
[*] [b]Upgraded Lighting:[/b] Real-time shadows and improved lighting on PCVR.
[*] [b]New Save System: [/b]More frequent saving across all platforms.
[*] [b]Bug Fixes & Improvements:[/b] Various issues resolved across all platforms.
[/list]
We can't wait for you to dive in and experience the latest updates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796408/cb6ab532812e3a629bed0e26b9c2e9ad266c3190.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.content: Added Mid Chapter Saves (the game saves collected puzzle pieces and creates checkpoints when you solve a puzzle/insert it into the plinth), Improved resolution and lighting/shadows as well as several bug fixes
